fix: Remove CloudKit container to fix crash on simulator

Changed NSPersistentCloudKitContainer to NSPersistentContainer since
CloudKit capability is not configured in Xcode. This was causing a
crash on the onboarding temperature selection page.

CloudKit can be re-enabled later by:
1. Adding iCloud capability in Xcode
2. Creating CloudKit container: iCloud.com.plungeheat.app
3. Changing back to NSPersistentCloudKitContainer
